ai_summary: Aries Agro Limited's 56th Annual General Meeting saw all resolutions pass, including the adoption of FY26 financial statements and the declaration of a Rs. 2.50 per share dividend. However, a notable red flag is the 7.52% shareholder dissent against the re-appointment and remuneration package for Managing Director Dr. Rahul Mirchandani, and the commission for Promoter Director Ms. Nitya Mirchandani. This level of opposition, significantly higher than other resolutions, indicates potential shareholder concerns regarding executive and promoter compensation.
